title: Personal Training Packages: combining the late-cancellation fee and the habitual surcharge into the total charge
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states how the late-cancellation fee (after any corporate wellness reduction) and the habitual-cancellation surcharge, where it applies, are combined into the single total amount charged for a late cancellation.

## Rule
The total amount charged for a late cancellation is the late-cancellation fee, after any corporate wellness reduction, added together with the habitual surcharge amount where the per-package habitual threshold has already been reached, or added with nothing where it has not. The two components are added together, never one applied on top of the other in a way that changes either component's own basis, and the combined total is rounded to 2 decimal places only at this final step, never at any earlier step.

## Points of judgement
Where the per-package habitual threshold has not yet been reached, the total charge is simply the late-cancellation fee after any corporate wellness reduction, with no surcharge added, rounded to 2 decimal places. Where the threshold has already been reached, the total charge is that same reduced fee plus the tier's own habitual surcharge amount, and the two are added together before the single rounding step is applied to their sum -- the fee is never rounded on its own before the surcharge is added, and the surcharge is never rounded on its own either.
